name: ChatGPT
good_for: Great for chatting, writing, homework help, planning trips, and turning word descriptions into pictures.
watch_out: The free plan is limited and can show ads; the Plus plan costs $20 a month.

name: Claude
good_for: Great for writing help, summarizing long documents, answering coding questions, and thinking ideas through carefully.
watch_out: The free plan runs out of messages fast on busy days; the Pro plan costs $20 a month when billed monthly.

name: Gemini
good_for: Great for quick answers, help inside Google apps like Gmail and Docs, and looking things up on the web.
watch_out: The free version has usage limits, and the paid AI Pro plan costs $19.99 a month.

name: Grok
good_for: Great for fun chats, quick questions, seeing what's happening on X right now, and making pictures from words.
watch_out: The free version only lets you ask so much each day, and you need an X account to sign in.

name: Perplexity
good_for: Great for looking things up and getting answers that show exactly which websites the facts came from.
watch_out: The free plan only gives you a few deep searches each day; unlimited searches cost $20 a month.

name: Llama
good_for: Free, powerful AI you can download and run on your own computer or through Meta's own apps.
watch_out: You have to set it up yourself or use someone else's app to talk to it.

name: Mistral
good_for: A fast, free chatbot made in Europe that answers questions, searches the web, and even makes images.
watch_out: The free plan has daily limits, and paid plans start at $14.99 a month.

name: Qwen
good_for: A free AI chat assistant that is strong in many languages and can also generate images.
watch_out: Running its biggest versions on your own computer needs serious hardware.

name: Midjourney
good_for: Beautiful AI pictures and art that look great, made by typing a simple description.
watch_out: There is no free plan and your pictures are public unless you pay more.

name: Stable Diffusion
good_for: Free AI picture-making that runs on your own computer with no subscription and no picture limits.
watch_out: You have to install it yourself and your computer needs a good graphics card.

name: Flux
good_for: It makes very detailed pictures from a short written description, like posters, art, or product mockups.
watch_out: Setting it up on your own computer takes some technical steps and a strong graphics card.

name: ElevenLabs
good_for: It turns your written words into natural-sounding spoken audio, great for videos, podcasts, or audiobooks.
watch_out: The free plan is small, so you will hit the monthly limit quickly if you make lots of audio.

name: Suno
good_for: It turns a few words about a style or theme into a full song with music and singing.
watch_out: Songs made on the free plan cannot be used for business or sold.

name: Runway
good_for: It turns your words or photos into short video clips for ads, social posts, or creative projects.
watch_out: You spend credits for each second of video, so longer videos use them up fast.

name: Cursor
good_for: It is an app where an AI assistant helps you write, fix, and explain code right in your editor.
watch_out: The free plan only includes a small number of AI requests each month.
